attributes.project_description: Describe Project Rebuild as the client's public rebuilding mission, selling an unlimited-mint NFT memoir on Base through FAMM, with a possible future BooksOnChain platform.
attributes.buyer_earnings: $5 instant referral commissions, Small and Big Block prize tickets, and a possible future BooksOnChain governance token.
attributes.referral_operation: Each NFT mint number is its permanent referral code; successful coded referrals earn $5 and current Small and Big Block tickets.
attributes.prize_block_description: Small Block awards 5 × $500 about every 500 mint or secondary sales; Big Block awards 5 × $10,000 about every 50,000 mint or secondary sales; pools are funded from every sale.
attributes.winner_selection: Chainlink VRF provides fully on-chain, provably fair winner selection verifiable on Basescan.
attributes.prize_ticket_rules: Each successful coded referral earns one entry in the current Small Block draw and one in the current Big Block draw; tickets expire after their block is drawn.
attributes.reward_claim: Commissions are sent automatically to the wallet; prize wins are announced on the Winners page and claimed through the website.
attributes.badge_description: On-chain badges are awarded at referral milestones 2, 10, 50, and 100+, are currently cosmetic, and may have future utility.
attributes.fiat_minting: Transak supports card, Apple Pay, and Google Pay minting without requiring existing crypto or a wallet.
attributes.wallet_participation: A wallet is needed for affiliate commission payouts or later NFT trading.
attributes.blockchain: Base, described as a fast, inexpensive, Coinbase-backed Ethereum L2.
attributes.fees: Mint price is exactly $15 and secondary sales carry a visible $10 flat royalty.
attributes.nft_sale_transfer: The buyer receives the book, original mint number as referral code, and earned badges; expired tickets remain expired.
attributes.referral_sharing: Users can copy the full referral link or share the mint number from the dashboard.
attributes.anti_scam_explanation: Explain that the model is single-level, has unlimited supply and verified source, and pays the client the same $4 cut on mints and secondary sales.
